classification: Corrected source-native Old English GP source, previously misnormalized fixture retained separately as legacy
source: Project Gutenberg eBook 9700, original Harrison/Sharp edition of Beowulf
normalization: Filter original verse lines with original line predicate; NFD strip combining marks; map ASCII-unconverted Unicode Ð/Þ/ð/þ→TH, Æ/æ→AE, Œ/œ→OE, ƿ/Ƿ→W, Ȝ/ȝ→G before uppercase; QU→CW, V→U, K→C, Z→S; greedy GP rune tokenization. Must handle lowercase BEFORE ASCII stripping. Original legacy data mapped only uppercase Ð/Þ and Æ before case folding, dropping thousands of lowercase letters.
